text:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT [P1] - Observability gap for tenant AstraMed in us-west-2 (dedicated VPC). Missing traces and log-forwarder auth failures during p95 surge. Paging oncall.
oncall-liv: Acknowledged. I'm on it — pulling traces now. Can someone confirm whether this is per-tenant forwarder (delegate role) or a wider forwarder pool issue? @mike @sara
mike: looks tenant-level from quick metric check. Logs from forwarder agents for AstraMed show 403 on sts:AssumeRole — delegate role token expired/denied. Other tenants unaffected.
sara: confirming. Metric partitioning shows spikes in putLogEvents errors only for tenant_id=astramed-*. Traces aren’t arriving past 12:03 UTC.
jen-cs: Customer impacted: AstraMed reports delayed audit logs ingestion affecting their compliance pipeline. They opened a ticket asking for ETA. Please keep CS updated.
kyra-ml: Noted — eval pipeline uses AstraMed traces for model drift alerts, those alerts might be noisy now.
oncall-liv: Root cause hypothesis: short-lived delegated credentials used by per-tenant forwarder expired and the refresh path failed due to missing IAM AssumeRole from new token broker instance in us-west-2.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: new token-broker (tb-1) in us-west-2 completed restart at 12:01 UTC — healthcheck passed. However role binding for arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/astramed-delegate not found in new instance config.
mike: that matches 403. The broker restart rolled config from S3 key config/token-brokers/us-west-2.json which still references older role ARN mapping; looks like automation didn't copy per-tenant overrides.
sara: mitigation plan: 1) re-provision token-broker with per-tenant mapping (hotfix) 2) create temporary fallback which issues long-lived scoped token to forwarder 3) trigger log-replay for missing window.
oncall-liv: I'll take the hotfix for token-broker. @mike can you prepare a fallback rollout (scoped token) and a template terraform change? Need approval to issue scoped tokens for max 2 hours.
mike: preparing terraform change now. snippet:
```
resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "astramed_delegate" {
  name = "astramed-delegate"
  role = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/astramed-delegate"
  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17",
    Statement = [{Action = ["sts:AssumeRole"], Effect = "Allow", Resource = "*"}]
  })
}
```
Note: this is a safe minimal policy for testing; will tighten for prod.
jen-cs: please ping me when you have the fallback so I can tell the customer. We need an ETA and a clear rollback plan.
infra-bot: infra-bot: applied config patch to tb-1 (dry-run) — mismatch still present. Suggest manual edit to include tenant mapping for astramed.
sara: manual edit approved. oncall-liv, do you want me to escalate to infra for manual role attach? I can take the log replay once tokens are available.
oncall-liv: Yes please. @infra-bot, apply manual tenant mapping now. Also create ACL so only astramed forwarder can use fallback token.
infra-bot: manual change applied at 12:13 UTC — tb-1 now recognizes astramed-delegate mapping. Confirmed: token-broker issues AssumeRole tokens again.
mike: issuing scoped fallback token now to forwarder: token_b64=eyJhbGci... (truncated). Pushing to forwarder config via ssm run-command.
oncall-liv: Forwarder accepted token and started re-sending logs at 12:18 UTC. I'm seeing traces trickle in (sampling still catching up).
jen-cs: Notified AstraMed support with current ETA: initial ingestion resumed, full replay expected ~30-45m. Customer acknowledged and asked for final confirmation when replay complete.
kyra-ml: model drift alerts suppressed for AstraMed until replay completes (I toggled the suppress flag). Will re-enable once traces stable.
sara: starting log replay job. command I'm running:
```
./tools/replay-logs --tenant astramed --since "2026-03-15T11:50:00Z" --to "2026-03-15T12:20:00Z" --destination forwarder://astramed
```
Expecting ~120MB, ETA ~20m.
oncall-liv: Handoff note for next oncall: hotfix applied, temporary token issued scoped to astramed for 2h. Token broker config rolled forward; validation done. Replay initiated — monitor logs_replay:status and traces_ingest:p95.
mike: followups: 1) automation fix to ensure per-tenant overrides are included on broker restarts (PR in progress) 2) rotate fallback token and remove after replay 3) verify KMS access for delegate role (policy currently allows assume but KMS decrypt might be missing).
sara: I'll own the replay completion and cleanup. I'll also coordinate with security to verify KMS key policy.
jen-cs: I'll keep AstraMed updated and close the ticket once you confirm replay finished.
oncall-liv: Summary for postmortem: token-broker restart dropped per-tenant mapping due to S3 sync race. Impact: 1 tenant (AstraMed) log/traces gap ~20-40m, affecting compliance pipelines and drift alerts. Mitigation: manual mapping, scoped fallback token, log replay. Action items: automation fix, KMS policy check, add replay monitoring alert.
inc-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED: status=mitigated by manual mapping + replay in progress. responders=[oncall-liv,mike,sara,jen-cs,kyra-ml]
sara: Replay completed at 12:38 UTC. Verified 100% of missing traces accepted and indexed, p95 latency returned to baseline. Cleaning up fallback token now.
mike: removed scoped token and rotated any test creds. PR for automation fix opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/token-broker-fix/pull/42
jen-cs: Customer notified, they confirmed compliance pipeline caught up. Closing ticket pending postmortem.
oncall-liv: Closing incident thread — will file postmortem with timeline and action items. Thanks all :white_check_mark: :eyes:
